audited_source_bank: A/B main 240 + Form C PR #281 draft 120
intent: Gap Stress Test: deliberately oversample weak/underrepresented law, NOT a NABP representative exam and NOT a calibrated readiness score
editorial_novelty_target: Every accepted item must test a materially different legal decision; >=96/120 should be entirely unseen or materially under-tested rules/exceptions, remaining <=24 may be genuinely new cross-law applications; do not count cosmetic reversals
source_policy: Exact current MA/federal law and all answer choices require separate source validation before drafting/freezing; potential legal scope gaps are research assignments, not claims.
question_format_policy: Nonpredictable mix of brief law recognition, compact real-world records, current official tables, integrated cases; no routine 5-item template; do not embed topic cues before exam.
exam_date_gate: If actual examination before 2027-03-01, remap to the then-operative NABP Competency Statements and keep this gap-first intent; if after, use 2027 Content Outline. Reverify any 2027-06-29 EUA changes on the actual exam date.
